name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Implement weekly automated scans of all prompts using exact string matching. This approach ensures that we can quickly identify and address any discrepancies or outdated content, fostering ongoing self-improvement in our prompts. The trade-off is that this method may not capture nuanced issues that require more context, but it provides a solid foundational check for quality and relevance. This consistent review process supports our goal of maintaining high standards in our output.

name: Gauge
text: Exact string matching misses 30-50% of near-duplicates that rephrase the same id—semantic similarity tools flag them reliably. A hybrid scan (exact + semantic) cuts false negatives without bloating noise; run it weekly, then manually audit the top 10% uncertain matches to settle the argument.
